# Pinned rather than left to the builder to choose.
#
# Nixpacks picks a Node version from a nixpkgs snapshot it controls, so
# `.nvmrc` and `engines` only narrow the choice — they cannot name a patch
# version. That produced two failed deploys in a row: first Node 18, which
# `@eslint/config-inspector` rejects, then 24.10.0, which
# `jsdoc-type-pratt-parser` rejects for wanting >=24.15.0. A Dockerfile ends
# the guessing, and builds the same way here as on Railway.
FROM node:26-slim AS build

WORKDIR /app

# Recent Node images no longer bundle Yarn, so it is installed explicitly and
# pinned to the version that wrote the lockfile.
RUN npm install --global yarn@1.22.22

# Dependencies first, so a source-only change reuses the cached install layer.
COPY package.json yarn.lock ./
RUN yarn install --frozen-lockfile

COPY . .
RUN yarn build

# Nuxt's build output bundles everything it needs, so the runtime image gets
# the output and nothing else — no node_modules, no source, no yarn.
FROM node:26-slim AS runtime

WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production

# Listen on every interface, but let the platform choose the port. Railway
# injects PORT and health-checks that, and Nitro resolves NITRO_PORT before
# PORT — so pinning NITRO_PORT here makes the app listen on 3000 while the
# healthcheck knocks on another door, which fails the deploy with nothing in
# the logs to explain it. Nitro falls back to 3000 when PORT is unset.
ENV NITRO_HOST=0.0.0.0

# Runs as root, deliberately. Railway mounts a volume owned by root, and a
# non-root process cannot create the store directory inside it — which fails
# on the first sign-in rather than at boot, so it looks like a broken app
# rather than a permissions problem. Dropping privileges would mean an
# entrypoint that chowns the mount and then steps down, which is more moving
# parts than a single-tenant app on one replica earns. If you do want a
# non-root user, chown the volume's mount path to it first.
COPY --from=build /app/.output ./.output

EXPOSE 3000

CMD ["node", ".output/server/index.mjs"]

name: Publish to npm

# Releasing is a version bump: change `version` in package.json, land it on main, and this
# ships it. The registry — not the git history — decides whether there is anything to do,
# so re-running this workflow, or landing an unrelated package.json edit, is a no-op.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: [package.json]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write # to tag the released commit
  id-token: write # to mint the OIDC token npm trades for a publish credential

# A half-finished publish is worse than a slow one.
concurrency:
  group: npm-publish
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: yarn
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org

      # Trusted publishing needs npm 11.5.1+, and Node 22 ships an older npm than that.
      - run: npm install -g npm@latest

      - id: check
        name: Is this version already on the registry?
        run: |
          name=$(node -p "require('./package.json').name")
          version=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          # `npm view` prints nothing for a version that does not exist, and fails
          # outright for a package that does not exist — an empty answer covers both.
          if [ -n "$(npm view "$name@$version" version 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
            echo "published=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::$name@$version is already published — nothing to do."
          else
            echo "published=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::$name@$version is new — publishing."
          fi

      - if: steps.check.outputs.published == 'false'
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - if: steps.check.outputs.published == 'false'
        run: yarn typecheck

      # `prepublishOnly` builds too; doing it here means a broken build fails the job
      # before anything touches the registry.
      - if: steps.check.outputs.published == 'false'
        run: yarn build

      # No token: npm exchanges the Actions OIDC token for a short-lived credential, and
      # attaches provenance automatically. See RELEASING.md for the one-time npm setup.
      - if: steps.check.outputs.published == 'false'
        run: npm publish

      - if: steps.check.outputs.published == 'false'
        name: Tag the released commit
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          gh release create "v${{ steps.check.outputs.version }}" \
            --title "v${{ steps.check.outputs.version }}" \
            --generate-notes

# --- Build the Tap binary from indigo ---
FROM golang:1.26-alpine AS tap-build
RUN apk add --no-cache git gcc musl-dev
ENV CGO_ENABLED=1
ENV GOTOOLCHAIN=auto
RUN go install github.com/bluesky-social/indigo/cmd/tap@latest

# --- Install deps and build the Nuxt app ---
FROM node:22-alpine AS node-build
RUN apk add --no-cache python3 make g++ libc6-compat
WORKDIR /app

COPY .yarnrc.yml package.json yarn.lock ./
COPY .yarn ./.yarn
COPY turbo.json tsconfig.base.json ./
COPY packages ./packages
COPY apps ./apps

RUN corepack enable && yarn install --immutable
RUN yarn build

# --- Runtime image: Node + tap binary + built outputs ---
FROM node:22-alpine AS runtime
RUN apk add --no-cache libc6-compat tini
WORKDIR /app

COPY --from=tap-build /go/bin/tap /usr/local/bin/tap
COPY --from=node-build /app/apps/keytrace.dev/.output ./apps/keytrace.dev/.output
COPY --from=node-build /app/apps/host ./apps/host

ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV KEYTRACE_DATA_DIR=/keytrace-data
ENV NITRO_HOST=0.0.0.0

ENTRYPOINT ["/sbin/tini", "--"]
CMD ["node", "apps/host/index.mjs"]

name: Publish to npm

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*"

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24

      - name: Enable Corepack
        run: corepack enable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --immutable

      - name: Build
        run: yarn build

      - name: Test
        run: yarn test

      - name: Publish packages
        run: |
          for pkg in packages/runner packages/claims packages/lexicon; do
            echo "Publishing $pkg..."
            cd "$pkg"
            npm publish --access public --provenance
            cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          done

name: Sync to Tangled

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure SSH
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.ssh
          echo "${{ secrets.TANGLED_SSH_KEY }}" > ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
          ssh-keyscan tangled.org >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts

      - name: Push to Tangled
        run: |
          git remote add tangled git@tangled.org:orta.io/keytrace.dev
          git push tangled main --force --tags

name: "Deployment"

on: push

  test:
    # the operating system it will run on
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # the list of steps that the action will go through
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout"
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: "Install Dependencies"
        run: yarn
      - name: "Build"
        run: yarn build
      - name: "Github Pages Deployment"

          git remote set-url origin https://git:${GITHUB_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git

        if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }} # only deploy main

name: Deploy to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build -- --base=/flurry/
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: dist

  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

name: Deploy to GitHub Pages

on:

  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install ImageMagick
        run: sudo apt-get install -y imagemagick

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Generate site
        run: node generate.js

      - name: Upload Pages artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: .

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deploy
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

name: Deploy to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: yarn

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build
        run: yarn build

      - name: Upload Pages artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: dist

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, dev]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, dev]

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  check:
    name: Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: clippy

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libssl-dev pkg-config libxkbcommon-dev libasound2-dev

      - name: Cache cargo
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/bin/
            ~/.cargo/registry/index/
            ~/.cargo/registry/cache/
            ~/.cargo/git/db/
            target/
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-features

      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --release

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libssl-dev pkg-config libxkbcommon-dev libasound2-dev

      - name: Cache cargo
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/bin/
            ~/.cargo/registry/index/
            ~/.cargo/registry/cache/
            ~/.cargo/git/db/
            target/
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --all-features

name: Flatpak Repository

on:
  release:
    types: [published, edited]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  flatter:
    name: Build Flatpak
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Skip pre-releases (only applies to release events)
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || !github.event.release.prerelease }}
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/andyholmes/flatter/rust:24.08
      options: --privileged

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust for vendoring
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Vendor dependencies
        run: |
          mkdir -p .cargo
          cargo vendor | head -n -1 > .cargo/config.toml
          echo 'directory = "vendor"' >> .cargo/config.toml
          tar pcf vendor.tar vendor
          rm -rf vendor

      - name: Import GPG key
        id: gpg
        uses: crazy-max/ghaction-import-gpg@v6
        with:
          gpg_private_key: ${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          passphrase: ${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}

      - name: Build
        uses: andyholmes/flatter@main
        with:
          files: com.github.orta.cosmic-soundcloud.json
          arch: x86_64
          gpg-sign: ${{ steps.gpg.outputs.fingerprint }}
          upload-bundles: true
          upload-pages-artifact: true
          flatpakrepo-name: cosmic-soundcloud
          flatpakrepo-title: COSMIC SoundCloud
          flatpakrepo-url: https://orta.io/cosmic-soundcloud
          flatpakrepo-description: SoundCloud client for COSMIC desktop

  deploy:
    name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: flatter
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}

    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

# Simple workflow for deploying static content to GitHub Pages
name: Deploy static content to Pages

on:
  # Runs on pushes targeting the default branch
  push:
    branches: ['main']

  # Allows you to run this workflow manually from the Actions tab
  workflow_dispatch:

# Sets the GITHUB_TOKEN permissions to allow deployment to GitHub Pages
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# Allow one concurrent deployment
concurrency:
  group: 'pages'
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # Single deploy job since we're just deploying
  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'yarn'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install
      - name: Build
        run: yarn build
      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v4
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          # Upload dist folder
          path: './dist'
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

# Copied from https://github.com/notlmn/browser-extension-template/blob/master/.github/workflows/deployment.yml
name: Deployment

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '31 13 * * 3'
  push:
    tags:
      - "20.*"
      - "21.*"
      - "22.*"
      - "23.*"
      - "24.*"

jobs:

  Build:
    outputs:
      created: ${{ steps.daily-version.outputs.created }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - run: npm install
    - run: npm test # This includes the build
    - uses: fregante/daily-version-action@v1
      name: Create tag if necessary
      id: daily-version
    - name: Update extension’s meta
      env:
        VER: ${{ steps.daily-version.outputs.version }}
      run: |
        echo https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/tree/$VER > distribution/SOURCE_URL
        npm run version
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        path: distribution

  Chrome:
    needs: Build
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || needs.Build.outputs.created
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/download-artifact@v2
    - run: cd artifact && npx chrome-webstore-upload-cli@1 upload --auto-publish
      env:
        EXTENSION_ID: ${{ secrets.EXTENSION_ID }}
        CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLIENT_ID }}
        CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.CLIENT_SECRET }}
        REFRESH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.REFRESH_TOKEN }}

  Firefox:
    needs: Build
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || needs.Build.outputs.created
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/download-artifact@v2
    - run: cd artifact && npx web-ext-submit@4
      env:
        WEB_EXT_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.WEB_EXT_API_KEY }}
        WEB_EXT_API_SECRET: ${{ secrets.WEB_EXT_API_SECRET }}

name: Test

on:
  - pull_request
  - push

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - run: npm install
    - run: npm test
module.exports = require('@redwoodjs/testing/config/jest/api')
module.exports = require('@redwoodjs/testing/config/jest/web')
